territory.label: The Receipt
territory.lens: itemized, audited transparency — every claim carries its number
territory.description: Treat the shoe like an invoice: publish the complete bill of materials, emissions and costs, and make checking the brand's work the core brand ritual.

big_idea: The Living Receipt: every pair ships with its audited, itemized footprint printed on the tongue and living at a public URL — and at mile 500 the receipt gets a second page: swap the outsole and midsole core with a rebuild kit and keep the same shoe on the books.

art_direction.imagery_direction: Forensic product macro photography under flat, even light: materials shot like lab evidence with their line-item data set beside them; no lifestyle gloss, nothing hidden in shadow.
art_direction.layout_notes: Invoice logic: strict column grid, tabular numerals, generous white margins; data rows set flush like a till receipt with a single accent rule.

copy.headline: Stop buying new shoes.
copy.subhead: Every pair publishes its audited footprint — materials, emissions, and the misses — where you can't avoid it.
copy.body: Most brands print a slogan on the tongue. We print the bill: 4.9 kg CO2e, 61% recycled upper, zero offsets, audited by people we can't fire. When a number improves, we update it. When it gets worse, we publish that too. You wouldn't train on vibes — don't buy on them either.

critique.case_against: Fusing receipts with rebuildability doubles the surface area a skeptic can attack: the brand must defend audit methodology and reverse-logistics economics at the same time, at seed stage, before either has a proof point. The mile-500 rebuild promise adds inventory, liability and sizing-continuity burdens that could starve the audit budget, and the combined story is harder to say in three seconds at a retail wall than either parent was. If one pillar slips — a late audit, a delayed kit — the failure discredits both, because the brand promised the receipt would always be current.

annotations.text: This is the brand: proof at purchase, proof at mile 500. The receipt gives Rebuild credibility; the rebuild gives Receipt a future beyond novelty. Ship it to packaging.
